fact_dispositions.prior_value: The callback table supplies three active Ground-component configurations and a zero terminator. The first component starts its map animation and otherwise has an always-false predicate and inert handlers. The second initializes its JObj, has an always-false predicate, performs the common Ground update, and has an inert final handler. The third initializes its JObj, registers a fighter traversal callback, has an always-false predicate, performs an auxiliary update followed by the common Ground update, and carries flag bits 30 and 31.
